NOTICE OF ADVERSE DETERMINATION - LEVEL OF CARE, INPATIENT VERSUS OBSERVATION

This letter is to advise you that following review of the clinical information submitted, Northgate Advantage has issued an adverse determination for level of care. The inpatient level of care billed for the above dates of service is not approved. Based on the records reviewed, the services provided could have been delivered safely at a lower level of care, such as observation.

BASIS FOR DETERMINATION

The review was conducted using the applicable MCG-style inpatient admission criteria for the condition under review. The following criteria were found not met:

PNA-01: Not met. Pneumonia severity scores indicated low risk suitable for outpatient treatment.

PNA-03: Not met. Blood pressure was stable without need for resuscitation.

No additional criteria codes were applied in reaching this determination.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT INFORMATION

The following codes apply to this claim: CARC CO-50, RARC N130.

This is an adverse determination of level of care, inpatient versus observation. It addresses only the appropriateness of the inpatient level of care billed for the dates of service identified above.

APPEAL AND RECONSIDERATION RIGHTS

A request for reconsideration may be submitted within the applicable filing window. Any clinical rationale submitted in support of reconsideration must map each finding to a numbered criterion as cited in this notice. Submissions that do not identify the specific numbered criterion associated with each clinical finding may be returned without substantive review.

Please note that level of care denials are not eligible for provider appeal. Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Requests received after that date will be closed without review.

Supporting documentation should reference the member ID and claim number shown above and be directed to the Utilization Management Department at the address printed on this notice.

A copy of the criteria used in this review is available upon written request at no charge.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Northgate Advantage
